chapter: Boston childhood, learning music and first gigs
title: Pianist Dan Carey and the black keys
summary: Dan Carey played in the hard keys and Hodges would follow him anywhere.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Now, I understand there was a pianist by the name of Dan Carey...
A great (?) man, a piano player. All the tough keys. B-flat, B-natural, F-sharp, C-sharp. He played the black keys on the piano.
And Hodges used to hang around with him and...?

Oh, Hodges picked his horn up and would go to anything he played. One key was the same as the other to him. He didn't know a good key from a bad key. He didn't know a hard one from the easy ones. They was all easy to him.
